_meta.purpose: paid re-observation (review) arm of the P3 restocking scheduler
_meta.review_mechanism: prefix 0.2 -> 0.6 -> 1.0, cost 1.0 per observation, at most K per trial and 2 per job, decision = expected lateness-probability gain net of 0.02 hurdle

coverage.note: the accept path needs a fired review to be exercised; the alpha=1.5 mapping provides 19/90 fired trials, the baseline mapping only 2/90

gate.note: the stochastic reference fixes the qlevel ceiling at 0.70 and GATE/LATE_TOL at 0.50/12.0, so q=0.70 is the only candidate that can be compared pointwise; q != 0.70 sweeps the same branch under a different pressure ceiling and is reported as an extension, not as a re-gated arm

no_review_cross_check.note: the no-review arm is run at the review-arm GATE/LATE (0.50/12.0); the two legacy combos (S2|a1.00_b0.50 gate .60, S3|a1.00_b0.50 late 20) are skipped by design

information_gain.source: code/p3_schedule.DHAT (frozen ridge predictions), eligible validation unit
information_gain.note: a paid review can only change a decision if pred(0.6) - pred(0.2) moves a scenario across the due date; a near-zero move means the second observation carries little information and the VoI hurdle is never met

verdict.rule: delta = mean(weighted_on_time_rate | review) - mean(... | no review), paired over 30 seeds; passes if delta >= 1.0 point and the paired-t 95% CI lower bound > 0 on ANY (case, q)
